posts.title: The Ollama browser extension I made to teach myself Dutch
posts.description: What would happen if AI became my native language teacher — not translating words, but explaining them through context, images, and exposure, the way a child learns from a parent? That question became the starting point for a small experiment.

posts.title: Structure your recon files before they structure you
posts.description: During the recon phase, establish a habit of structuring files to maintain organization as the number of files grows. Create a rule or better a tool (which I shared here) to streamline the process and avoid repetitive steps.
